runner.pid_one_namespace_link_policy: the PID 1 namespace link may be blank when host procfs returns no target, but a nonblank link must match host_pid_namespace; self host namespace, PID 1 /proc and ps identity, and unrestricted procfs are all mandatory
runner.competing_process_policy: no build, test, evaluation, model-serving, or database workload during a repetition

fixture.provider_result: deterministic unit-normalized vector derived from FNV-1a(input, seed)
fixture.corpus_identity: the entry run records sha256 over newline-delimited canonical generated records; every checkpoint/final run must match that sha256 byte-for-byte

execution.checkpoint_and_final_order: identical to entry with entry_ replaced by candidate_
execution.stop_rule: after 60 seconds, stop admission at the next completed 10-operation epoch and drain accepted work

starvation_rule.rule: while a class has admitted unfinished work, every non-overlapping five-second window must contain at least one completion for canonical writes, projections, foreground queries, and direct embeds; both workload directions must pass

comparison_rule.noise: entry_MAD = median(abs(entry_repetition_value - entry_median)) across the three entry repetitions
comparison_rule.evaluation_scope: compare each named throughput rate and each shared latency class/percentile independently within projection_heavy and foreground_heavy; candidate-only dispatch and resource metrics are mandatory correctness evidence, never entry comparisons; no metric or direction may offset another
comparison_rule.throughput_floor: for each throughput rate and direction: candidate_median >= entry_median - max(0.10 * entry_median, 3 * entry_MAD)
comparison_rule.latency_ceiling: for each latency class, percentile, and direction: candidate_median <= entry_median + max(0.15 * entry_median, 3 * entry_MAD)
comparison_rule.precision: derive rates and latency values from raw monotonic nanoseconds as binary64 values; do not round before evaluating a comparison
hard_requirements: all pre-existing acceptance thresholds pass unchanged
the starvation rule passes in both directions
queue and projection admission never exceed the accepted configuration-derived bounds
thread and SQLite inventories equal the accepted configuration-derived counts
close leaves zero engine-owned residual workers except a contractually reported hung provider call with no database ownership
comparison_rule.invalid_environment: any runner mismatch, corpus/protocol hash mismatch, process monitor outside host PID namespace or without unrestricted host /proc visibility including matching runner PID in /proc/self and ps, non-performance governor, competing workload, swap-in/out during a repetition, or missing applicable raw metric invalidates that repetition rather than counting as pass or fail; historical_unavailable metrics are explicitly unavailable at entry, never imputed as zero
